name: Tome of the Cabal
summary: Your search for the Tome of the Cabal leads from Ironforge to a lost manuscript and a sunken ship. Its scattered pages hold rites for binding a felhunter.

sections.title: A Divided Grimoire
sections.body: Only one copy of the Tome of the Cabal was ever written, and violence left it in pieces. Its remnants were torn apart, defaced, and scattered to distant corners of the world. A tattered manuscript, ripped from the binding, crossed the sea to Kalimdor and fell into the hands of centaur clans. The other section was sent by sea from Lordaeron toward Khaz Modan, but its vessel sank before reaching port.

sections.title: Across Sea and Canyon
sections.body: The missing pages lie beyond two dangers. Pages lost at sea washed ashore on the Hillsbrad coast, west of Southshore, where shoreline murlocs near Azurelode Mine took the waterlogged relics and wreckage. The dry half lies in Splithoof Hold in Thousand Needles, deep in centaur caverns, inside an ancient chest. Once the pieces are together, Krom Stoutarm can inspect the lost text before it returns to Strahad Farsan.

faq.q: What is the Tome of the Cabal?
faq.answer: The Tome of the Cabal is a rare demonic grimoire, and only one copy exists. Its arcane knowledge holds the incantations and binding rites warlocks need to summon and subdue a felhunter from the Twisting Nether.

faq.q: Who is Krom Stoutarm and why does he want the tome?
aliases: why does krom want the book
faq.answer: Krom Stoutarm is an Ironforge dwarf who studies rare and forgotten texts. He tells Alliance warlocks where the tome's pieces ended up, asking only to study them once they are recovered.

faq.q: Where did the two pieces of the book end up?
faq.answer: The Moldy Tome washed ashore on the Hillsbrad coast, west of Southshore near Azurelode Mine, where coastal murlocs scavenged it. The Tattered Manuscript lies in a battered chest deep in a centaur cavern at Splithoof Hold in Thousand Needles, Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why was the tome torn apart in the first place?
faq.answer: Only one copy of the Tome of the Cabal was ever transcribed. In its murky past, someone deliberately defaced it, tore a large section from the binding, and carried it to Kalimdor; the rest was lost at sea on a voyage to Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Who is Strahad Farsan and what does he have to do with this quest?
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan is an experienced warlock who lives near Ratchet in the Barrens. He directs aspiring summoners to recover the tome and learn the rites for summoning and binding a felhunter under his tutelage.

faq.q: Why is the Moldy Tome covered in sea grime?
faq.answer: The Moldy Tome was aboard a ship sailing from the Lordaeron coast to Menethil Harbor, but the ship never arrived. Its wreck drifted near the Hillsbrad shore, where coastal murlocs near Azurelode Mine gathered the damp, moldy pages.

angles.text: As a warlock, recovering the grimoire's torn halves marks a rite of passage. Its pages hold the summoning rites needed to draw a felhunter from the Nether and enslave it.
As an Alliance practitioner, you can rely on Ironforge contacts such as Krom Stoutarm to trace rare demonic relics across continents without drawing open suspicion from church or crown.
